# Aqua PPRC Pipes & Fittings

> Aqua PPRC is a leading manufacturer of high-grade PPRC (Polypropylene Random Copolymer) pipes, fusion fittings, and flow control valves based in Faisalabad, Punjab, Pakistan.

## Company Overview
- **Brand Name:** Aqua PPRC Pipes & Fittings
- **Factory Address:** Chak 117 JB, Millat Road, Faisalabad, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Flagship Outlet:** Asia Pipe Store, Railway Road, Sadiq Market, Faisalabad
- **Primary Email:** sales@aquapprc.com
- **Product Range:** Single-layer PPRC pipes (PN20, PN25), Double-layer 2-layer PPRC pipes (PN20, PN25), socket couplers, female/male threaded sockets, 90° elbows, female elbows, reducing elbows, mixer elbows, equal tees, female tees, reducing tees, gate valves, full bore gate valves, fancy gate valves, ball valves, plastic unions, over cross bridges, end caps, and threaded plugs.

## Product Catalog & Specifications
- [Products Catalogue](/products): Complete listing of all 21 PPRC pipes, fittings and valves.
- [Single-Layer PPRC Pipe](/products/single-layer-pprc-pipe): High-density PN20 and PN25 PPRC water pipes (Sizes: 25mm to 63mm).
- [Double-Layer PPRC Pipe](/products/double-layer-pprc-pipe): 2-Layer co-extruded PPRC pipes (Sizes: 25mm to 63mm).
- [PPRC Sockets](/products/pprc-socket): Straight fusion couplers (25mm to 63mm).
- [Female Threaded Socket](/products/female-threaded-socket): PPRC socket with female brass insert (25x1/2" to 63x2").
- [Male Threaded Socket](/products/male-threaded-socket): PPRC socket with male brass insert (25x1/2" to 63x2").
- [90° Fusion Elbow](/products/90-degree-fusion-elbow): Directional elbows (25mm to 63mm).
- [Equal Fusion Tee](/products/equal-fusion-tee): 3-way branch fittings (25mm to 63mm).
- [PPRC Gate Valves](/products/pprc-gate-valve): Handwheel line control valves (25mm to 63mm).
- [Technical Reference](/technical): Detailed dimensions, connection standards, and quality specifications.
